mapper.insert: insert into t_media_upload (upload_id, owner, total_size, chunk_size, created_at, updated_at) values (#{uploadId}, #{owner}, #{totalSize}, #{chunkSize}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: select upload_id as uploadId, owner, total_size as totalSize, chunk_size as chunkSize, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt from t_media_upload where upload_id = #{uploadId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
select count(*) from t_media_upload where owner = #{owner,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.update: update t_media_upload set updated_at = #{updatedAt,jdbcType=BIGINT} where upload_id = #{uploadId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
